sources.title: Synthetic organization registration snapshot
sources.summary: The fictional Northstar Training Lab lists northstar-lab.invalid as its public training domain. All registration details are fabricated.

sources.title: Synthetic DNS inventory
sources.summary: A fabricated DNS snapshot lists vpn.northstar-lab.invalid and staging.northstar-lab.invalid. The example address 192.0.2.44 is reserved for documentation.
sources.collection_method: Bundled synthetic DNS fixture; no DNS query is performed

sources.title: Synthetic staff directory entry
sources.summary: A fabricated profile associates the handle analyst-amber with the synthetic organization and analyst-amber@northstar-lab.invalid.

sources.title: Synthetic repository metadata
sources.summary: Fabricated repository metadata references staging.northstar-lab.invalid and the analyst-amber handle. No repository host or network is contacted.

sources.title: Synthetic onboarding document index
sources.summary: A fabricated document index repeats the analyst-amber handle and references the vpn.northstar-lab.invalid service. It contains no real schedules or personal information.

sources.title: Synthetic public status post
sources.summary: A fabricated status post from northstar-training mentions a maintenance window and northstar-lab.invalid. The post is not published on a real social platform.
